proposed_cache_move.reason: Conservative preservation of complete ignored cache, including failed attempts and historical snapshots; avoids treating matching factual rows or reproducibility assumptions as disposal authority.

verification_steps: Wait for actual merge confirmation; stop all author-local build/test/browser/server/watch/queue writers before inventory snapshot and moves.
Run allocator check and verify exact root slot token; require same filesystem for rename, exclusive absent targets, ordinary source paths and no symlink substitution.
Rehash all seven complete databases against recorded SHA/length and check absence of WAL/journal sidecars; if changed, inventory new vintage and preserve it separately.
Write exclusive per-file source/destination/length/SHA receipt for all ignored-cache regular files after writers stop; record symlink link-text without following outside author.
Rename each exact database and the whole ignored cache into proposed private destinations without overwriting; retain all seven distinct vintages.
Read back destination whole lengths/hashes and complete path inventories, and durably save exclusive final receipt outside author.
Inspect remaining ignored/untracked files. Remove only verified regenerable node_modules/dist/Vite/pyc artifacts; retain any uncertain file.
Verify no dirty/untracked/ignored/trust-flag files remain and release exact owned slot from primary checkout using exact token.
limits: No large files moved/copied/deleted during this preflight.
Cache sizes are a live inventory, not final immutable snapshot; queue logs can still grow.
Geographic/archive tables in SQLite have counts only; all seven backups must be retained.
Outside-cache archive is private handoff storage after task completion, not a new unmanaged worktree or reproduction baseline.
Stored paths/tokens/private receipts must remain uncommitted.
